ad_library.summary: Visionteknewenergy is running 11 distinct live Meta creatives, every one started 12 Nov 2026 except a Diwali creative from 6 Nov 2026 - a single coordinated launch, which means this is a fresh, actively managed account rather than a stale one. Meta groups them, reporting '2 ads use this creative and text' on each, so the real number of ads is higher than the number of distinct IDs. Five of the eleven send the click to a bare instagram.com root and one to fb.me; the remaining five carry no outbound link at all. Google Ads Transparency for visiontek.solar returns 0 ads under region=IN, so Meta is the entire paid channel.

defects.title: Not one of the eleven live ads carries a visiontek.solar link
defects.detail: Five creatives send the click to a bare instagram.com root, one to an fb.me short link, and five carry no outbound link at all. A click on instagram.com lands on the Instagram home feed - not a profile, not a post, not a message thread - so that traffic has nowhere to go and cannot be attributed. Only the fb.me creative resolves to anything owned, and that is a Facebook short link.

defects.title: No sitemap and no robots.txt
defects.detail: Both https://visiontek.solar/sitemap.xml and https://visiontek.solar/robots.txt return 404 Page Not Found. There is no crawlable index of the site and no crawler instruction, on a domain with a product catalogue, a blog and individual product pages.

defects.title: Every social media link on the contact page is a dead anchor
defects.detail: The contact page renders four social icons - Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn and Instagram - and all four point at contact-us#, i.e. nowhere. The one social presence that does exist, facebook.com/Visionteknewenergy, is where the 11 live ads run, and the site does not link to it.

defects.title: 'Download Catalogue' does not download a catalogue
defects.detail: The FUTURE+ 5KVA Hybrid Inverter block on the product page renders 'Download Catalogue (PDF, 1.2 MB)' as a link to visiontek.solar/product# - an anchor on the same page. There is no PDF behind it. A buyer trying to get the datasheet gets nothing.

defects.title: The homepage advertises four of the six product lines
defects.detail: The homepage's Featured Products section carries RISE+, FUTURE+, VAULT+ and PULSE+. The product page carries those plus NEXUS+ and the Nexus+ cloud platform. Two of the six lines a visitor can read about on the product page are invisible from the front door.

defects.title: A broken video element is printed as visible text
defects.detail: The product page renders 'Your browser does not support video.' in the page body, which means a video player with no playable source is shipping to every visitor.

summary: Visiontek Solar Energy is the solar division launched in 2025 by VISIONTEK Linkwell Telesystems, a 32-year-old telecom and power-electronics manufacturer in Begumpet. It is running 11 live Meta creatives launched in a single coordinated push on 12 Nov 2026, and the site behind them is in genuinely good shape - every image has alt text, each page has one H1, and the contact page has tappable phone, email, WhatsApp and a working form. The problems are structural: there is no sitemap and no robots.txt at all, and not one of the eleven ads carries a link to the site, so none of the spend can reach any of it.
